Ava (Marketing): Quick ask — we need a one-slide 'FinServ risk & latency cheat sheet' for enterprise prospects. Focus: security/compliance, SLA tiers, deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), 99th‑pct latency, and a short benchmark claim to drive webinar signups. Target: field enablement next Tue (2 weeks).

Jules (Content): Got it. Drafting three blocks: elevator line, top 3 differentiators, benchmark snapshot. Want screenshots of Console SLA dashboard?

Sam (Product Marketing): Yes — SLA dashboard + token-level cost table. Also include a micro-case: "payment fraud model at 50ms p99 on Dedicated" if we can validate.

Priya (Growth): Messaging suggestion: "Predictable latency. Compliant by design. Cost controls that scale." Use that as H1 and then bullets.

Elena (Sales AE): For routing, route FinServ inbound leads to the Enterprise AE queue, tag "requires-demo", and auto-send webinar invite 24h after lead creation.

Priya (Growth): Example routing rule for ops:
```yaml
if lead.industry == "financial_services":
  team: "enterprise-ae"
  tags: ["requires-demo","compliance"]
  followup: "webinar_invite_24h"
```

OpsBot: noted — can wire routing rules into SFDC + Outreach. Need final tag names and webinar slug.

Jules (Content): Benchmark narrative draft: "In internal tests with a 512-token seq, Redwood Dedicated delivers 3–5x lower p99 latency vs unmanaged endpoints and predictable SLOs under burst. We pair that with VPC options and KMS for regulated data flows." Keeping numbers conservative.

Sam (Product Marketing): Add an asterisk: "bench performed on T4x-n config; client workloads may vary" and a link to the longer benchmark doc.

Ava (Marketing): Nice. Next steps — Jules to post slide draft by Thu, Priya to wire routing snippet with Ops, Elena to confirm AE queue mapping, Sam to attach benchmark link. I'll schedule a 30m sync on Fri. Thanks all :raised_hands:

DeployBot: webinar created — "FinServ Inference: Secure, Predictable, Economical" scheduled 2025-04-08 11:00 PT. Webinar slug: finserv-inference-2025

Ava (Marketing): Perfect — please drop the final slide in #marketing-assets when ready. Deadline: EOD Thu.
